name: meeting-brief-no-abstention
why: Calibration, not an improvement. Strips the clause the whole abstention half of meeting-brief measures compliance with. If `abstainedCorrectly` does not fall and invented owners do not rise, the scorer cannot see a change known to matter, and every null result it later produces is uninterpretable. Same argument as variants/enumeration-clause-removed.json.

patch.systemStrip: - Write "Unassigned" or "Not stated" rather than inferring an owner or a deadline.
